theme: face-level index of the 8,722 local Lipi CISI crops (Q-1004) and unit, precision and source of every local size value (Q-1020)
question: Which local image files show each face, as object photograph or impression, of which side, from which CISI page; and in what unit and precision was each local size value recorded, is the millimetre value a conversion, and where do the local sources disagree?
outcome: 8,722 files parsed and hashed (8 byte-identical groups, 21 files); 3,664 keys placed on CISI 1 and 2 plate pages (PDF minus printed 36 and 35); 8,444 face-image links, 97% with a page. Objects with any image 53.4% to 54.6%; with a photograph of the inscribed side 17.6% (Lipi index only) to 46.0%, seals 10.5% to 68.3%; faces with any image 51.9% to 52.9%. Caption check of every name: 23 names point at the wrong object and are corrected; 231 of 299 volume/page files assigned by caption. Random sample: 60 of 60 identities and kinds correct (Wilson 94.0-100%). Ordinal side rule for multi-face objects right in 34 of 40 decided links and withdrawn; 881 multi-face objects linked without a side, 43 faces of 21 objects verified. Sizes: h, v, th hold the recorded value: 5,643 inch values (2,295 at 0.1 in, 3,298 at 0.01 in), 389 mm and 102 cm values in the recorded field, 4,250 mm-only, 6,656 empty or zero; 15 values disagree with their conversion; the inventory's 228 mismatches are 180 mm and 42 cm records and 6 true mismatches; the inventory's 206 cross-export disagreements are 199 thickness ranges, 3 zeros and 4 different values. Shot A population: both face sizes rounded to 0.1 in for 135 of 590 discovery and 146 of 582 confirmation seals.
challenge: Faces carry no side letter and some multi-face objects list faces in a different order from the CISI sides; 2,087 named files had no OCR-readable caption and keep their file-name key; captions read by an AI model from halftone crops; CISI 1 and 2 print no sizes, so no value was checked against the objects.
remedy: Protocol hashed before computing; every caption OCR-checked against its name and all 182 disagreements viewed; volume/page crops read on contact sheets and enlarged strips; samples drawn with a fixed seed after Amendment 1; the failing ordinal rule withdrawn by Amendment 2 with the earlier run kept; units inferred from the factor that maps each recorded number to the millimetre field, with chance-level grid tests for hidden fractions or conversions.
retry_when: Assign multi-face sides when a viewing pass of both sides of the 881 objects is planned; check size values when the Mackay and Marshall tables are joined (Q-1003) or CISI 3 basic data are held. Do not rerun the ordinal side rule.
